bosses.description: 扑袭、双落点追击、扑袭与根区围堵；无额外无敌阶段。
bosses.description_en: Pounce, double impact, then pounce with roots; no added invulnerability phase.
bosses.name: 伏岚古兽

bosses.description: 开闭炉门形成输出窗口，生命降低时增加错位喷发。
bosses.description_en: Cycling furnace doors create damage windows; lower health adds offset eruptions.
bosses.name: 炉心巨傀

bosses.description: 两侧交替潮墙，齿间保留穿越窗口；生命降低时加密齿列，末期双侧齐发并加池环与辐射弹幕。
bosses.description_en: Alternating side tide walls with crossing gaps between teeth; lower health adds teeth, then both sides at once with pool rings and a radial barrage.
bosses.name: 沉潮双鳍

bosses.description: 三阶段依次使用：短暂护盾与扇射；锚环冲击与召援；扑袭与延迟落点冲击。先避开预警区再反击。
bosses.description_en: Three phases: brief shields and fan volleys; anchor-ring strikes and reinforcements; pounces and delayed impact strikes. Dodge the warning zones, then counterattack.
bosses.name: 千镜司枢

bosses.description: 三阶段依次使用：多道预警俯冲；多方向封印射线；环状连续喷发。先避开预警区再反击。
bosses.description_en: Three phases: multiple warned dive lanes; seal rays from several directions; successive ring eruptions. Dodge the warning zones, then counterattack.
bosses.name: 照夜霜鹫

bosses.description: 三阶段依次使用：环形持续孢区；环状脉冲与辐射弹幕；旋转十字潮线。先避开预警区再反击。
bosses.description_en: Three phases: lingering rings of spores; nexus pulses and radial projectiles; rotating cross-shaped tide lanes. Dodge the warning zones, then counterattack.
bosses.name: 泽心孢母

bosses.description: 三阶段依次使用：锚环冲击与召援；扑袭与延迟落点冲击；短暂护盾与扇射。先避开预警区再反击。
bosses.description_en: Three phases: anchor-ring strikes and reinforcements; pounces and delayed impact strikes; brief shields and fan volleys. Dodge the warning zones, then counterattack.
bosses.name: 悬锚巨灵

bosses.description: 三阶段依次使用：多方向封印射线；环状连续喷发；多道预警俯冲。先避开预警区再反击。
bosses.description_en: Three phases: seal rays from several directions; successive ring eruptions; multiple warned dive lanes. Dodge the warning zones, then counterattack.
bosses.name: 守庭无面
bosses.planning_description: 组合封印与关键解除窗口

bosses.description: 三阶段依次使用：环状脉冲与辐射弹幕；旋转十字潮线；环形持续孢区。先避开预警区再反击。
bosses.description_en: Three phases: nexus pulses and radial projectiles; rotating cross-shaped tide lanes; lingering rings of spores. Dodge the warning zones, then counterattack.
bosses.name: 归脉中枢
bosses.planning_description: 关闭输送节点后开放核心；收束此前六类目标经验

missions.briefing: 学习移动、自动攻击、拾取与升级；45秒后风带开放，72秒后进入东侧撤离圈。
missions.briefing_en: Learn movement, automatic attacks, pickups and upgrades. Wind lanes open at 45s; enter the eastern exit after 72s.
missions.description: 引导移动、自动攻击与首次升级
missions.description_en: Survive objective in Gale Ravine; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 风口初行
missions.planning_description: 引导移动、自动攻击与首次升级
missions.success_text: 风口初行完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: First Steps in the Wind complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 三个根钉错位布置，迫使离开安全直线 击破3个锚点；依编号击破，未激活目标免伤。 前往下一锚点的敌人会提前从侧面接近，留意来路。
missions.briefing_en: Gale Ravine: Pull the Root Nails. Destroy 3 marked anchors; inactive anchors cannot be damaged. Enemies approach the next anchor early from the flanks; watch the route.
missions.description: 三个根钉错位布置，迫使离开安全直线
missions.description_en: Break objective in Gale Ravine; 3 marked target(s).
missions.name: 拆除根钉
missions.planning_description: 三个根钉错位布置，迫使离开安全直线
missions.success_text: 拆除根钉完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Pull the Root Nails complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 陪采药人经过四个路标；起步、北段转弯与南段归路分别出现敌人。靠近才前进，可离队拦截后返回。
missions.briefing_en: Escort the herbalist through four waypoints. Enemies arrive at departure, the north turn and the southern return. Stay nearby to move; intercept enemies and return.
missions.description: 在风带间护送一名缓行目标
missions.description_en: Escort objective in Gale Ravine; 4 marked target(s).
missions.name: 护送采药人
missions.planning_description: 在风带间护送一名缓行目标
missions.success_text: 护送采药人完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Escort the Herbalist complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 沿足迹依次寻找三处线索；首处可选择机缘，末处发现断枝兽。躲开直线预警，利用冲锋后的停顿反击。 每条线索释放8点悟性；靠近绿色光点即可吸引拾取。
missions.briefing_en: Follow three ordered clues. Choose an encounter at the first; reveal the beast at the last. Dodge the warned charge and counter during its rest. Each clue releases 8 XP; approach green motes to collect them.
missions.description: 沿可见足迹追猎，避免被引入根区
missions.description_en: Hunt objective in Gale Ravine; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 追踪断枝兽
missions.planning_description: 沿可见足迹追猎，避免被引入根区
missions.success_text: 追踪断枝兽完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Track the Broken-Bough Beast complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 清空两个净化圈并各累计停留6.6秒；开始净化后两组有限增援会交错接近。离圈或敌人靠近只暂停进度。
missions.briefing_en: Clear each circle and hold for 6.6s. Two limited reinforcement groups approach in sequence after cleansing begins. Leaving or nearby enemies pauses progress.
missions.description: 两个净化区交替受压
missions.description_en: Cleanse objective in Gale Ravine; 2 marked target(s).
missions.name: 清理风井
missions.planning_description: 两个净化区交替受压
missions.success_text: 清理风井完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Cleanse the Wind Well complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 应对远程与侧袭交替的敌潮；60秒后出现一只断枝兽精英，92秒后进入西侧撤离圈。
missions.briefing_en: Face alternating ranged and flanking waves. One elite arrives after 60s; enter the western exit after 92s.
missions.description: 远程刺群与追击兽首次混编
missions.description_en: Survive objective in Gale Ravine; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 守住归路
missions.planning_description: 远程刺群与追击兽首次混编
missions.success_text: 守住归路完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Hold the Way Home complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 依次拆除三锚：永久关闭北、东、西南根区，包括尚未生效的预警。安全空间随拆锚扩大。 前往下一锚点的敌人会提前从侧面接近，留意来路。
missions.briefing_en: Break three ordered anchors to permanently shut down north, east and southwest roots, including pending warnings. Enemies approach the next anchor early from the flanks; watch the route.
missions.description: 三处锚点产生不同进攻角度
missions.description_en: Break objective in Gale Ravine; 3 marked target(s).
missions.name: 拔除井心锁
missions.planning_description: 三处锚点产生不同进攻角度
missions.success_text: 拔除井心锁完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Break the Well Locks complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 击败伏岚古兽：扑袭、双落点追击、扑袭与根区围堵。沿预警留出的空隙移动并反击。 每次突破首领阶段释放18点悟性，可在战斗中完善构筑。
missions.briefing_en: Defeat the beast through pounce, double impact, then pounce with root containment. Use gaps in the warnings to counterattack. Each boss phase break releases 18 XP to develop your build during combat.
missions.description: 读取扑袭后摇并利用根区空隙
missions.description_en: Boss objective in Gale Ravine; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 伏岚古兽
missions.planning_description: 读取扑袭后摇并利用根区空隙
missions.success_text: 伏岚古兽完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Ancient Gale Beast complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 在灰翼与背炉群中坚持79秒，再进入东侧撤离圈。沿矿轨绕开橙色喷口预警。
missions.briefing_en: Survive 79 seconds, then reach the east exit. Dodge orange vent warnings along the rails.
missions.description: 横向飞掠迫使改变走位节奏
missions.description_en: Survive objective in Ember Kilns; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 穿过灰翼群
missions.planning_description: 横向飞掠迫使改变走位节奏
missions.success_text: 穿过灰翼群完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Cross the Ash Wings complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 依次拆除三座喷口控制器；每座永久关闭对应喷口，包括正在预警的喷发。
missions.briefing_en: Break the three controls in order. Each permanently shuts its vent, including pending warnings.
missions.description: 攻击锚点时避开轮替喷发
missions.description_en: Break objective in Ember Kilns; 3 marked target(s).
missions.name: 关闭三座喷口
missions.planning_description: 攻击锚点时避开轮替喷发
missions.success_text: 关闭三座喷口完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Close Three Vents complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 护送冷却匣沿北侧矿轨通过四个路标。靠近才前进，喷口预警期间可离队清理侧袭。
missions.briefing_en: Escort the cooling casket through four north-rail waypoints. Stay close to move; intercept flankers during vent warnings.
missions.description: 把缓行冷却装置带过热带
missions.description_en: Escort objective in Ember Kilns; 4 marked target(s).
missions.name: 护送冷却匣
missions.planning_description: 把缓行冷却装置带过热带
missions.success_text: 护送冷却匣完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Escort the Cooling Casket complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 击败标记的熔脊行者。它沿途留下预警热迹，绕开热迹并在转向时反击；每次突破生命阶段获得8点悟性。
missions.briefing_en: Defeat the marked Furnace Warden. Circle its warned heat trail and counter while it turns. Each health phase break grants 8 XP.
missions.description: 追击留下热区的目标并选择切线
missions.description_en: Hunt objective in Ember Kilns; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 截住背炉首领
missions.planning_description: 追击留下热区的目标并选择切线
missions.success_text: 截住背炉首领完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Hunt the Furnace Carrier complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 清空两个炉灰圈并各累计停留7.2秒。每圈开始时有有限增援；离圈或敌人靠近暂停进度。
missions.briefing_en: Clear two ash circles and hold each for 7.2 seconds. Limited reinforcements arrive when cleansing starts; leaving or nearby enemies pauses progress.
missions.description: 净化区之间有喷口轮替
missions.description_en: Cleanse objective in Ember Kilns; 2 marked target(s).
missions.name: 洗净炉灰
missions.planning_description: 净化区之间有喷口轮替
missions.success_text: 洗净炉灰完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Wash Away Furnace Ash complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 护送炉工通过五个路标。抵达中段后暂停整备，可选稳妥或冒险机缘，再继续撤离。
missions.briefing_en: Escort workers through five waypoints. Pause at the midpoint for a safe or risky encounter, then continue evacuation.
missions.description: 双阶段护送，中途可停靠安全点
missions.description_en: Escort objective in Ember Kilns; 5 marked target(s).
missions.name: 撤出炉工
missions.planning_description: 双阶段护送，中途可停靠安全点
missions.success_text: 撤出炉工完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Evacuate the Workers complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 任意顺序切断三根燃芯管；对应喷口立即关闭，尚未关闭的喷口保持原有预警节拍。按危险区域选择先后。
missions.briefing_en: Cut three fuel pipes in any order. Each shuts its matching vent immediately; remaining vents retain their warning cycle. Choose which danger to remove first.
missions.description: 破坏顺序改变剩余喷口节奏
missions.description_en: Break objective in Ember Kilns; 3 marked target(s).
missions.name: 切断燃芯管
missions.planning_description: 破坏顺序改变剩余喷口节奏
missions.success_text: 切断燃芯管完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Cut the Fuel Pipes complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 炉心巨傀关门3秒减伤，开门2.5秒恢复全额伤害。三阶段依次使用单喷发、双喷发、三向封路；橙圈完整预警后才生效；每次突破阶段获得18点悟性。
missions.briefing_en: The furnace closes for 3 seconds with reduced damage, then opens for 2.5 seconds at full damage. Three phases use one, two, then three warned eruptions. Each phase break grants 18 XP.
missions.description: 炉门开启窗口输出，关闭时处理热区
missions.description_en: Boss objective in Ember Kilns; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 炉心巨傀
missions.planning_description: 炉门开启窗口输出，关闭时处理热区
missions.success_text: 炉心巨傀完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Furnace Heart Golem complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 在潮蟹与汲水灵群中坚持86秒；三片潮池错峰翻涌，随蓝色预警更换安全滩，再进入东侧撤离圈。
missions.briefing_en: Survive 86 seconds; three staggered tide pools force you to move between shoals on the blue warnings, then reach the east exit.
missions.description: 涨潮期间更换安全滩
missions.description_en: Survive objective in Sunken Tide; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 守住涨潮口
missions.planning_description: 涨潮期间更换安全滩
missions.success_text: 守住涨潮口完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Hold the Rising Shore complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 击败携账册的覆潮祭卫；蟹甲护卫在前方与侧翼拦路。它潜地蓄水、出水爆发，出水窗口内输出；每次突破生命阶段获得8点悟性并打断其回潜。
missions.briefing_en: Defeat the ledger-carrying Sunken Tide Warden while crab guards block the lanes ahead and to the flank. It dives to recharge and bursts on surfacing; strike while it is up. Each health phase break grants 8 XP and staggers its dive.
missions.description: 追猎携物目标，不让护卫挡住路线
missions.description_en: Hunt objective in Sunken Tide; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 夺回船队账册
missions.planning_description: 追猎携物目标，不让护卫挡住路线
missions.success_text: 夺回船队账册完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Recover the Fleet Ledger complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 护送渡船沿旧港航路通过四个路标。靠近才前进；潮池涨水时先离队等待，中段停靠可选稳妥或冒险机缘，再继续开船。
missions.briefing_en: Escort the ferry through four harbor waypoints. Stay close to move; wait out surging flats, choose a safe or risky encounter at the midpoint stop, then sail on.
missions.description: 随短航线移动，处理侧行拦路敌
missions.description_en: Escort objective in Sunken Tide; 4 marked target(s).
missions.name: 护送渡船
missions.planning_description: 随短航线移动，处理侧行拦路敌
missions.success_text: 护送渡船完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Escort the Ferry complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 清空两个净化圈并各累计停留7.8秒。南圈与潮池相叠：涨水时退到潮池远端的月牙区，月牙区可全程停留。
missions.briefing_en: Clear two circles and hold each for 7.8 seconds. The south circle overlaps a tide pool: fall back to the far crescent during surges; the crescent is safe to hold throughout.
missions.description: 退潮开放额外净化位置
missions.description_en: Cleanse objective in Sunken Tide; 2 marked target(s).
missions.name: 净化旧港
missions.planning_description: 退潮开放额外净化位置
missions.success_text: 净化旧港完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Cleanse the Old Harbor complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 依次拆除三座水闸印；每拆一座，对应潮池立即失去休潮、永久翻涌。趁预警期离开池区再拆下一座；与关闭热喷口相反，本章安全空间随拆印逐步递减。
missions.briefing_en: Break the three sluice seals in order. Each removes its flat's rest phase for good — leave the flat during the warning after each break. Unlike closing thermal vents, safe ground here shrinks as you progress.
missions.description: 闸印影响不同水流方向
missions.description_en: Break objective in Sunken Tide; 3 marked target(s).
missions.name: 拆除水闸印
missions.planning_description: 闸印影响不同水流方向
missions.success_text: 拆除水闸印完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Break the Sluice Seals complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 在潜鳍兽与汲水灵群中坚持106秒；地面跃出预警与直线喷流交替，再从西侧撤离。
missions.briefing_en: Survive 106 seconds through burrowing fins and water jets, then reach the west exit.
missions.description: 地面跃出预警与喷流混合
missions.description_en: Survive objective in Sunken Tide; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 穿越潜鳍群
missions.planning_description: 地面跃出预警与喷流混合
missions.success_text: 穿越潜鳍群完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Cross the Fin Swarm complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 与覆潮祭卫决斗；后路伏击不断。出水窗口内输出，每次阶段突破打断回潜蓄水并获得8点悟性。
missions.briefing_en: Duel the Sunken Tide Warden while rearguard ambushes cut off your retreat. Strike while it surfaces; each phase break staggers its dive and grants 8 XP.
missions.description: 打断蓄水并抢占退路
missions.description_en: Hunt objective in Sunken Tide; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 追击深庭祭卫
missions.planning_description: 打断蓄水并抢占退路
missions.success_text: 追击深庭祭卫完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Hunt the Deep Court Warden complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 沉潮双鳍在两侧交替竖起潮墙，齿列之间留有穿越窗口；生命降低时加密齿列，末期双侧齐发并加池环与辐射弹幕。每次突破阶段获得18点悟性。
missions.briefing_en: The Twin Fins raise tide walls on alternating sides with crossing gaps between the teeth; lower health adds teeth, then both sides at once with pool rings and a radial barrage. Each phase break grants 18 XP.
missions.description: 两侧潮流交替，保留明确穿越窗口
missions.description_en: Boss objective in Sunken Tide; 1 marked target(s).
missions.name: 沉潮双鳍
missions.planning_description: 两侧潮流交替，保留明确穿越窗口
missions.success_text: 沉潮双鳍完成。新的道路已经开放。
missions.success_text_en: Twin Fins of the Tide complete. The next route is open.

missions.briefing: 击破三个节点，逐一关闭对应危险区；依编号拆除。 拆除对应节点停止后续喷发；已经出现的预警仍会生效。
